rabbit.recognition: Two long upright ears, whiskers and nose, small vertical hops. Keep the ears high; never use this silhouette for wings.

bird.recognition: Broad wings spread sideways and flap vertically, a small triangular beak. Bird emotion changes eyebrows, not the wing silhouette.

cat.recognition: Two SHORT outward-pointing ears, slanted eyes and whiskers, curious head tilt. Short ears distinguish it from the rabbit.

fish.recognition: Small side fins, swimming side-to-side; visor shows a fish profile with triangular tail and bubbles.

car.recognition: Round arms LOW at the sides are two wheels; windshield, headlights and grille on visor, subtle suspension bounce.

train.recognition: Locomotive face with two windows, central headlight and chimney; side arms reciprocate like piston rods.

helicopter.recognition: Long slender arms spread horizontally ABOVE the head as rotor blades; visor cockpit and skids, bounded hover with a back-and-forth rotor sweep (no real flight).

sailboat.recognition: One upright thin arm is a mast, the other is a broad diagonal sail; visor sail and hull, gentle side-to-side rocking.

clock.recognition: Circular dial with hands on visor; two thin arms form differently oriented hands and sweep a short arc, without spinning the whole robot.

umbrella.recognition: Two raised arms spread outward as a canopy; visor shows the dome, shaft and hooked handle. A slight tilt suggests shelter from rain.

camera.recognition: Two small round hands grip a camera; visor is a camera outline with round lens and flash; lens briefly narrows like a shutter.

heart.recognition: Heart outline on visor, two rounded hands frame it BELOW the visor without covering the drawing; slow heartbeat expands the hands and adds a tiny lift.

tree.recognition: Wide diagonal arms are branches, leafy tree pictogram with trunk on visor; slow sway in the wind, not upright animal ears.

rain.recognition: Round arms high above the body are cloud lobes; visor cloud and descending rain strokes. Clouds stay above, raindrops move down.

wave.recognition: Arms alternate high and low like rolling crests; visor shows water ripples and a curling wave; gentle body roll, no extra water objects.

flower.recognition: Rounded arms unfold sideways as petals; five-petal flower pictogram and stem on visor; slow opening with a small lift.
